waylight.config.title: Waylight
waylight.config.option.lantern_type.desc: Choose whether Waylight renders a normal lantern or a soul lantern.
Choose whether the lantern sits on your right hip, left hip, or in your left hand.
waylight.config.option.first_person_ligh: Keep the lantern's light active in first person even when the hip model is hidden.
waylight.config.option.first_person_hand: Choose whether the first-person hand lantern follows physics or stays visually stable.
waylight.config.option.extinguish_underw: Leave the lantern visible, but let it go out while you are fully submerged.
waylight.config.option.auto_equip_in_dar: Automatically light the lantern when the local brightness falls to or below the threshold. While active, you cannot put it away in darkness.
waylight.config.option.auto_unequip_in_b: Automatically put the lantern away once the local brightness rises above the threshold. While active, you cannot light it in bright areas.
waylight.config.option.auto_light_thresh: Sets the local brightness cutoff for auto-light behavior. Lower values wait for darker areas; higher values trigger sooner.
Scale how strongly the lantern reacts to movement, turns, jumps, and falls.
waylight.config.option.debug_anchor_gizm: Show a small RGB gizmo at the lantern anchor for placement and rotation tuning.
